action_for_astronaut: Protect the next sleep window: dim cabin light 1 h before bed, use sleep station, avoid screens/caffeine late.
Request schedule adjustment for next shift; consider a short nap before critical tasks; log sleep aid use.
Flag as cumulative sleep debt: avoid safety-critical tasks until a full sleep opportunity is recovered.
Do not start a demanding task alone; run the 3-min vigilance test; pair with a crewmate.
Performance below fitness-for-duty range: defer complex procedures, recover sleep, retest in 12 h.
Alertness below your own baseline: plan a recovery sleep, retest tomorrow.
Take a scheduled break, private family conference or private psychological conference.
Behavioral health check-in with crew medical officer; schedule private conference with ground.
Report overload to mission control to rebalance the timeline.
Re-measure at rest; if still elevated with fatigue or stress, notify crew medical officer.
Dose higher than usual today: check space weather alerts; limit time in low-shielding areas.
Possible solar particle event: follow the radiation alert procedure and move to the most shielded area of the station; ground radiation team confirms.
